data.name: Adlei
data.gender_notes: Adlei is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew word 'Adonai' meaning 'Lord' or 'God'. The name Adlei is a reminder of the divine presence and power within each individual. The name Adlei carries the meaning “Man of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Adlei usually hope their child will grow to embody man of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Adlei belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Man of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Adlei total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: אדלי
in_hebrew.meaning: אדלי הוא שם שפירושו ענוג או חביב
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אדלי הוא שם עברי שפירושו ענוג או חביב. הוא נגזר מהשורש ע־ד־ל, שפירושו להיות ענוג או נעים. השם אדלי מופיע בתנ״ך ככינוי לאחד מנשאי הנביאים.

in_greek.name: Άδλεις
in_greek.long_meaning: Άδλεις είναι ένα ελληνικό όνομα που σημαίνει χαριζόμενος ή αγαπητός. Η ετυμολογία του ονόματος προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή γλώσσα και σχετίζεται με την έννοια του 'ענוג' ή 'χαριζόμενος'.

in_latin.name: Adlei
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Adlei derivatur ex hebraeo et significat delectabilis vel amabilis. Nomen hoc in traditione christiana invenitur et saepe coniungitur cum conceptu spirituali amoris et gratiae.

in_english.name: Adlei
in_english.meaning: Adlei means delightful or beloved in Christian tradition
in_english.long_meaning: The name Adlei originates from Hebrew roots, specifically from the root 'ע־ד־ל', meaning 'to be delightful' or 'beloved'. Although not directly mentioned in the Bible, the name Adlei carries significant spiritual connotations of being cherished or loved by God. Historically, names with similar roots have been used in Jewish and Christian traditions to signify a special bond with the divine. The name Adlei is associated with positive personality traits such as being amiable, pleasant, and endearing.
